en-US.description: Cross-platform SSH, SFTP, and terminal client for developers, sysadmins, and homelabs.
en-US.longDescription: ZestSSH is a cross-platform SSH, SFTP, and terminal client for Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, and iOS. It brings a tabbed desktop shell with split panes, jump-host chaining, port forwarding, an SFTP file browser, snippets and workflows, live server monitoring, and optional end-to-end encrypted sync across every device, all backed by a single shared connection library.
en-US.name: ZestSSH
en-US.releaseNotes: ZestSSH 3.3.0: each account on a computer keeps its own hosts, keys and settings, locked when it signs out; passkeys for two-step sign-in; a team can be deleted with seven days to undo it, and vault access set for one member; hosts that are SFTP only; team seats bought in the app; the Support Hub; inviting many people at once; sync to Cloudflare R2 fixed. On every device in a team, update to 3.3.0.
